name: ht-cms-demo-clear
description: State-X Eligibility & Enrollment demo with CLEAR Verify Assist identity verification and Case Assist caseworker guidance. Single Render web service.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,resident,admin,verify -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @demo/server" "npm run dev -w @demo/resident" "npm run dev -w @demo/admin" "npm run dev -w @demo/verify"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @demo/server && npm run build -w @demo/resident && npm run build -w @demo/admin && npm run build -w @demo/verify
